title: Workspace sweep: extension-server README 'How to use' and trait code blocks omit caller parameter and don't compile
description:
Sweep the extension-server siblings' README files for two README-as-contract issues that bd:JMAP-qz9v.37 and bd:JMAP-qz9v.38 fixed in jmap-contacts-server:

1. The 'How to use' section's code block does not compile — incomplete impl block (no JmapBackend supertrait methods, no type Error / type CallerCtx).
2. The 'Backend trait' code block omits caller: &Self::CallerCtx on every method despite the source carrying it post-CallerCtx refactor (workspace commit 514352c).

Canonical jmap-mail-server (README.md:30+) has the same stale shape — its trait block lacks the caller parameter and its 'How to use' example uses the same incomplete impl placeholder. Same probable shape in the other extension-server siblings: jmap-chat-server, jmap-calendars-server, jmap-tasks-server, jmap-filenode-server, jmap-sharing-server, jmap-metadata-server.

Fix: bring each crate's README into the shape jmap-contacts-server now uses:
- Code blocks marked rust,ignore (schematic, not claimed to compile).
- Trait method signatures include caller: &Self::CallerCtx as the first parameter on every method.
- 'How to use' block uses a typed Dispatcher<MyCallerCtx> + Arc<my_backend> + a pointer to the lib.rs doctest for the runnable, verified variant.

Per workspace canonical-template propagation rule, fix jmap-mail-server first then propagate to the other siblings in the same pass.
